; Single-entry WeRead launcher for exact supported 3.28 firmware.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/settings/Settings.qml
    IMPORT cn.rmtool.WeReadLauncher 1.0

    TRAVERSE ?#settingsSidebar
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property var rmtoolWeReadSettingsRoot: parent

            function rmtoolWeReadSelectedPage() {
                return ("_selectedPage" in rmtoolWeReadSettingsRoot)
                    ? rmtoolWeReadSettingsRoot._selectedPage
                    : rmtoolWeReadSettingsRoot._selectedIndex
            }

            function rmtoolSelectWeReadPage(page) {
                if ("_selectedPage" in rmtoolWeReadSettingsRoot) {
                    rmtoolWeReadSettingsRoot._selectedPage = page
                } else {
                    rmtoolWeReadSettingsRoot._selectedIndex = page
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE ?#settingsSidebar > ColumnLayout#settingsColumn
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.SidebarItem {
                id: rmtoolWeReadSidebarItem
                objectName: "rmtoolWeReadSidebarItem"
                type: ArkTokens.Sidebar.primary
                text: showLabels ? "微信读书" : ""
                iconSource: "qrc:/rmtool/wereader.png"
                highlighted: settingsSidebar.rmtoolWeReadSelectedPage() === 1003
                focusPolicy: Qt.StrongFocus
                Layout.fillWidth: true

                onTriggered: {
                    settingsSidebar.rmtoolSelectWeReadPage(1003)
                    sidebarTimer.running = true
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE ?#payloadLoader
        REBUILD sourceComponent
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM /{/
            INSERT STREAM /if (settingsSidebar.rmtoolWeReadSelectedPage() === 1003) return rmtoolWeReadLauncher;/
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE Item#root
        LOCATE BEFORE Component#general
        INSERT {
            Component {
                id: rmtoolWeReadLauncher

                Item {
                    id: rmtoolWeReadPage
                    objectName: "rmtoolWeReadLauncherPage"

                    readonly property string group: "RmtoolWeReadLauncher"
                    readonly property bool fastModeAvailable: true
                    property string mode: "normal"
                    property int colorRefreshPages: 10
                    property int monoRefreshPages: 10
                    property string launchStatus: ""
                    property string installationError: ""

                    WeReadLauncher {
                        id: rmtoolWeReadBridge
                    }

                    function normalizedMode(value) {
                        if (value === "colorFast" || value === "monoFast") {
                            return value
                        }
                        return value === "fast" ? "monoFast" : "normal"
                    }

                    function normalizedRefreshPages(value) {
                        var number = Number(value)
                        return number === 5 || number === 10 || number === 20
                            || number === 30 || number === 0 ? number : 10
                    }

                    function readSettings() {
                        mode = normalizedMode(Settings.rawValue(group, "mode"))
                        colorRefreshPages = normalizedRefreshPages(
                            Settings.rawValue(group, "colorRefreshPages"))
                        monoRefreshPages = normalizedRefreshPages(
                            Settings.rawValue(group, "monoRefreshPages"))
                    }

                    function setMode(value) {
                        if (value !== "normal" && !fastModeAvailable) {
                            return
                        }
                        Settings.setRawValue(group, "mode", normalizedMode(value))
                        readSettings()
                    }

                    function activeRefreshPages() {
                        return mode === "colorFast" ? colorRefreshPages : monoRefreshPages
                    }

                    function setRefreshPages(value) {
                        var normalized = normalizedRefreshPages(value)
                        if (mode === "colorFast") {
                            Settings.setRawValue(group, "colorRefreshPages", normalized)
                        } else if (mode === "monoFast") {
                            Settings.setRawValue(group, "monoRefreshPages", normalized)
                        }
                        readSettings()
                    }

                    function nativeMode() {
                        return mode === "colorFast" ? 2 : mode === "monoFast" ? 1 : 0
                    }

                    function launch() {
                        launchStatus = ""
                        if (installationError.length > 0) {
                            launchStatus = installationError
                            return
                        }
                        if (mode !== "normal" && !fastModeAvailable) {
                            launchStatus = "快刷模式暂不支持当前固件"
                            return
                        }
                        var refreshPages = mode === "normal" ? 0 : activeRefreshPages()
                        if (!rmtoolWeReadBridge.launch(nativeMode(), refreshPages)) {
                            launchStatus = rmtoolWeReadBridge.lastError()
                        }
                    }

                    Component.onCompleted: {
                        readSettings()
                        installationError = rmtoolWeReadBridge.unavailableReason()
                    }

                    ScrollArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        contentWidth: width
                        contentHeight: rmtoolWeReadWrapper.childrenRect.height
                            + ArkControls.Values.platform.spacing.x2large
                        enableScrollbar: true
                        permanentScrollbar: true
                        scrollbarTopMargin: rmtoolWeReadHeader.y

                        Item {
                            id: rmtoolWeReadWrapper
                            implicitWidth: parent.width

                            ArkControls.PlaceholderBar {
                                id: rmtoolWeReadPlaceholder
                                width: parent.width
                            }

                            ArkControls.Title {
                                id: rmtoolWeReadHeader
                                type: ArkControls.Title.Large
                                anchors {
                                    top: rmtoolWeReadPlaceholder.bottom
                                    left: parent.left
                                    leftMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                    right: parent.right
                                    rightMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                }
                                text: "微信读书"
                            }

                            ColumnLayout {
                                anchors {
                                    top: rmtoolWeReadHeader.bottom
                                    topMargin: ArkControls.Values.platform.spacing.x2large
                                    left: parent.left
                                    leftMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                    right: parent.right
                                    rightMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                }
                                spacing: ArkControls.Values.platform.spacing.x2large

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "启动模式"
                                    description: rmtoolWeReadPage.mode === "colorFast"
                                        ? "保留彩色，交互更跟手；可能积累残影。手写笔保持最低延迟，可定期完整刷新。"
                                        : rmtoolWeReadPage.mode === "monoFast"
                                            ? "牺牲彩色，黑白显示更稳定、彩色残影更少。手写笔保持最低延迟，可定期完整刷新。"
                                            : "使用微信读书官方显示与刷新方式。"
                                    showAttachment: true
                                    attachment: RowLayout {
                                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                                        spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.medium

                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: "普通"
                                            type: rmtoolWeReadPage.mode === "normal"
                                                ? ArkTokens.Button.primary
                                                : ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            onClicked: rmtoolWeReadPage.setMode("normal")
                                        }

                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: "彩色快刷"
                                            type: rmtoolWeReadPage.mode === "colorFast"
                                                ? ArkTokens.Button.primary
                                                : ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            enabled: rmtoolWeReadPage.fastModeAvailable
                                            opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
                                            onClicked: rmtoolWeReadPage.setMode("colorFast")
                                        }

                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: "黑白快刷"
                                            type: rmtoolWeReadPage.mode === "monoFast"
                                                ? ArkTokens.Button.primary
                                                : ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            enabled: rmtoolWeReadPage.fastModeAvailable
                                            opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
                                            onClicked: rmtoolWeReadPage.setMode("monoFast")
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    visible: rmtoolWeReadPage.mode !== "normal"
                                    label: "强制完整刷新"
                                    description: "按阅读页数定期恢复一次完整彩色刷新。"
                                    showAttachment: true
                                    attachment: RowLayout {
                                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                                        spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.medium

                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: "5 页"
                                            type: rmtoolWeReadPage.activeRefreshPages() === 5
                                                ? ArkTokens.Button.primary
                                                : ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            onClicked: rmtoolWeReadPage.setRefreshPages(5)
                                        }
                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: "10 页"
                                            type: rmtoolWeReadPage.activeRefreshPages() === 10
                                                ? ArkTokens.Button.primary
                                                : ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            onClicked: rmtoolWeReadPage.setRefreshPages(10)
                                        }
                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: "20 页"
                                            type: rmtoolWeReadPage.activeRefreshPages() === 20
                                                ? ArkTokens.Button.primary
                                                : ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            onClicked: rmtoolWeReadPage.setRefreshPages(20)
                                        }
                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: "30 页"
                                            type: rmtoolWeReadPage.activeRefreshPages() === 30
                                                ? ArkTokens.Button.primary
                                                : ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            onClicked: rmtoolWeReadPage.setRefreshPages(30)
                                        }
                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: "从不"
                                            type: rmtoolWeReadPage.activeRefreshPages() === 0
                                                ? ArkTokens.Button.primary
                                                : ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            onClicked: rmtoolWeReadPage.setRefreshPages(0)
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "启动微信读书"
                                    description: rmtoolWeReadPage.installationError.length === 0
                                        ? "退出微信读书后会返回系统界面。"
                                        : rmtoolWeReadPage.installationError
                                    action: ArkControls.Button {
                                        text: "启动"
                                        type: ArkTokens.Button.primary
                                        enabled: rmtoolWeReadPage.installationError.length === 0
                                            && (rmtoolWeReadPage.mode === "normal"
                                                || rmtoolWeReadPage.fastModeAvailable)
                                        onClicked: rmtoolWeReadPage.launch()
                                    }
                                }

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "无法启动"
                                    description: rmtoolWeReadPage.launchStatus
                                    visible: rmtoolWeReadPage.launchStatus.length > 0
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
